purpose: screen the complete first bounded current active MLB Gamma page once for future-event same-threshold full-game Over plus first-five Under guaranteed-payout packages without event-by-event polling

source_contracts.use: official public unauthenticated GET events contract documenting tag_id active closed limit offset order and ascending filters
retained exact official Gamma event response binding MLB tag id 100381

population.future_only: event startTime must be strictly after the retained request completed_at_ms
population.complete_rule: returned count strictly below the frozen limit of 100
population.partial_rule: returned count equal to 100 is explicitly partial and cannot support a complete-population claim

payoff_identity.relation: at an identical half-run threshold cumulative full-game runs are never below cumulative first-five runs so full-game Over plus first-five Under pays at least one pUSD per share
payoff_identity.cancellation: both exact markets must state 50-50 cancellation so the package still pays one pUSD per share

decision_rules.candidate: exact future active accepting full-game and first-five total markets with identical line complete rules and displayed price sum strictly below one
decision_rules.deterministic_best: largest optimistic per-share headroom then earliest startTime event slug and numeric line
decision_rules.next_if_candidate: freeze one exact-depth screen for only the deterministic best candidate
decision_rules.next_if_none: stop without any book or fee request
